Fixed CVE-2026-109618 (PHP2Shell) version fallback false negatives (#17493)

* Fixed CVE-2026-109618 version fallback false negatives

Align the version fallback with the official affected range from
GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w and GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp (< 8.2.35, < 8.3.36,
< 8.4.27, < 8.5.12):

- report EOL branches below 8.2 instead of returning null
- run the version fallback when a probe is rejected (e.g. nginx 413)
- treat dev/alpha/beta/RC builds of fixed versions as vulnerable
- read the PHP version from the Server header as well

* Update CVE-2026-109618.yaml

Add CVE-2026-90817 - REDCap >= 13.3.0 Unauthenticated RCE via Survey Passthru (#17446)

* Add CVE-2026-90817 - REDCap >= 13.3.0 Unauthenticated RCE via Survey Passthru

* Fix CVE-2026-90817 template metadata and request flow

- Remove the malformed first request block (GET {{BaseURL}}&__passthru=...):
  for a bare-host target {{BaseURL}} has no query string, so the request
  never matched. The survey-hash discovery block now runs first and feeds
  {{survey_hash}} into the passthru probe.
- Remove the kev tag: CVE-2026-90817 is not in the CISA KEV catalog
  (checked against catalog 2026.10.16, 1748 entries).
- Set verified: false. The matcher has not been exercised against a live
  instance; validated locally with nuclei -validate and against a mock.
- Align cwe-id with the CVE record (CWE-73,CWE-94) and set max-request: 4
  (the template can send up to 4 requests).
- Add the Securifera advisory to references.

* Update CVE-2026-90817.yaml

---------
